name: IA-FiLM
chinese: 恒等锚定的表型条件化影像特征调制
output_deviation: The requested /data experiment directory creation returned EIO (errno 5); execution is under /tmp as explicitly requested by the user. Artifacts are pending migration, not archived under /data.

film.reference: mean of real, train-only standardized age plus male/female one-hot rows
film.age_imputation: valid outer-train median; fallback 17.0 only if every outer-train age is invalid
film.age_scaling: outer-train imputed mean and population SD (ddof=0); constant SD becomes 1

mechanism_subgroups.age_group_boundaries: fixed inclusive lower, exclusive upper; invalid-age imputation counted separately

research_judgement_operationalization.candidate_go_requires_auc: For F2-F1, F3-F2, F3-F4, and F3-historical D4/M1/M3, mean probability-AUC delta is positive, at least 6/10 paired folds are positive, and every leave-one-fold-out mean remains positive.
research_judgement_operationalization.candidate_go_requires_class_balance: F3 mean ACC, SEN-ASD, and SPE-TD are each no lower than historical D4, M1, and M3.
research_judgement_operationalization.candidate_go_requires_mechanism: F3 has nonzero measured modulation and native gradient; F4 true-versus-wrong conditions change the captured test representation; all four groups retain exact train-reference identity.
research_judgement_operationalization.otherwise: NO_GO; this is a conservative candidate screen, not statistical significance or a MICCAI acceptance claim.

F4_permutation.scope: separately within train, validation and test, then SITE_ID
F4_permutation.derangement: random cyclic derangement for groups of size >=2; singleton unchanged

historical_m3.ph_aux_F1_F2: real age/sex-conditioned ph prototype CE + 0.25 * original stopped-image-teacher KL
historical_m3.ph_aux_F3_F4: real age/sex-conditioned ph prototype CE only

training.selection: strict minimum native validation CE + original Graph loss; native EarlyStopping
training.resume_policy: validated complete artifacts skip; retries use identical frozen source, historical start and seed
